events.content:
Implemented a small, account-free reading shelf. The home page separates books you’re reading from finished books. You can add a title, author, and notes, mark a book finished, and open a book’s own page to see its details and share its link.

Books are saved to `data/books.json`, which the server creates on first launch and Git ignores. Start the app with `npm start`; it listens on port 3000 by default. Set `PORT` to use a different port.

I checked the server and front-end JavaScript syntax with `node --check`. I did not run a test suite.

Files: [server.mjs](/workspace/server.mjs), [index.html](/workspace/public/index.html), [app.js](/workspace/public/app.js), [styles.css](/workspace/public/styles.css).
